description: sfxnz's two-DGX-Spark vLLM TP2 recipe for the official DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental checkpoint (snapshot 86f746b3, an older snapshot than the newest official revision 6821d6ad) on the digest-pinned eugr spark-vllm-b12x image. Upstream's official ViT/aligner vLLM plugin (dsv4_vision, subclassing DeepseekV4ForCausalLM so DSpark keeps lm_head) and its DSpark loader patch are baked byte-identically. Serves OpenAI image_url input (8 images per prompt) with fused DSpark-6, B12X MoE, fp8 KV pinned at 12 GiB, the native 1,048,576-token window, two sequences (the only occupancy upstream measured; its run.sh refuses more, a larger KV pin, a window above 1M on fp8, a smaller pin above a 289,024 window, and draft lengths not divisible by 3, and the wrapper enforces the same guards without upstream's FORCE_UNSAFE_CTX override), thinking off by default. Upstream measured 26.2 tok/s prose at concurrency 1 and 20.5 per stream at 2 (40.5 aggregate) on its own lab (claims, not measured here); a 200,013-token needle missed and a 1M needle was not run. Known upstream limit: image-token expert routing (ffn.gate.bias_vl) is not applied on the B12X text path. Host RAM headroom after boot is about 8 GiB upstream; memory and disk envelopes use that statement, the 8 GiB reserve, and an assumed 25 GB image. Not options: VLLM_USE_B12X_MHC (kernel rejects this model's rms_norm_eps 1e-20), VLLM_ENFORCE_STRICT_TOOL_CALLING=0 (this vLLM's strict tool grammar assumes a reasoning block on every DeepSeek V4 request, so a thinking-off named or required tool call could not stop; the JSON-schema grammar serves those calls), the KV pin, sequence count and window (guarded), block size, MoE backend. Licences are information only: recipe scripts and model weights MIT. Vonk physical acceptance is pending. Default reasoning is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: Upstream default: thinking=false, reasoning_effort=low.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental sfxnz vLLM two Sparks
